meta.purpose: Incident-driven fix proposal. Receives a sentry/drift signal and creates an improvement_proposal via fn_create_improvement_proposal (gated inside: anomaly_key dedup + 3/h rate-limit + risk eval + auto-approve only low-risk/full-autonomy, else pending). LLM patch rendering is a downstream factory step (deferred, mirrors AISHA_SELF_TOOLING factory).

parameters.rpcParams: ={{ JSON.stringify({ p_agent_slug: $json.agent_slug, p_category: $json.category, p_description: $json.description, p_metadata: $json.metadata, p_title: $json.title }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ proposal_id: $('Create Proposal').first().json.proposal_id || null, risk_level: $('Create Proposal').first().json.risk_level || null, status: $('Create Proposal').first().json.status || $('Create Proposal').first().json.error || 'unknown' }) }}
